info.name: Listrak Cross Channel REST app-push-mobile-client-device TransactionalMessageResend API

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: transactionalMessageId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the transactional message.

params.name: resendKey
params.description: Key of the transactional message to resend.

params.name: forwardAddress
params.description: Email address destination for the resend. If none is specified, the original address is used.

items.docs: Resends a transactional message to the specified forwarding address. If no address is specified, the message will be sent to the original recipient.
